results.title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
results.overview: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

results.title: Once Upon A Time, We Loved
results.overview: In 2006, 18-year-old Bảo spends the final summer of his youth with his closest friends in a quiet coastal town, surrounded by unfinished dreams and endless possibilities. The arrival of Quỳnh—a worldly and emotionally complex woman—awakens feelings he has never experienced before, pulling him out of the safe orbit of his ordinary life. Their passionate romance soon triggers a chain of irreversible events, beginning with a death that changes everything. Twenty years later, the echoes of that summer still linger in silence. Can Bảo truly understand love—and finally forgive himself?

results.title: Between Us Girls
results.overview: Three friends, Naika, Zhenya, and Alisa, embark on a traditional spa weekend to escape their routine and family roles, but especially their mothers-in-law. Their plans are ruined when Naika's future mother-in-law, Margarita Pavlovna, unexpectedly joins them, and the three friends' escape from reality and everyday life turns into a true test of their friendship. It turns out they all view life differently.

results.title: The Christmas Heartbeat
results.overview: Following sudden cardiac arrest, Julia Winters is forced back to her Nashville hometown, where Christmas never fades and old wounds still linger. To truly move forward, she must confront the past she thought she’d left behind—and the future she never saw coming.

results.title: Variations on a Theme
results.overview: An elderly goat herder falls victim to a scam promising long-awaited reparations for her father's WWII service. Structured as a series of recurring visual 'variations', Variations on a Theme is a portrait of endurance and loss.

results.title: An Island Away From You
results.overview: A romantic comedy set in the breathtaking Canary Islands. After being left at the altar, uptight chef Harry is convinced by his best friend to escape to her homeland, Gran Canaria. There, amid stunning beaches, vibrant culture, and delicious cuisine, Harry rediscovers joy—and unexpectedly falls in love with his best friend's father. Woven with humor, heart, and sun-soaked adventures, the film is a celebration of second chances and the power of unexpected love.

results.title: The Negotiator «Operation Damascus»
results.overview: Colonel Andrey Zbrodin receives an emergency order to fly to Syria and establish contact with militants in the city of Douma. Unarmed, Zbrodin enters enemy territory. The lives of hundreds of hostages and civilians depend on his negotiations. His opponent is the field commander Abu Humam.

results.title: Supertramp: Crime of the Century in Concert at Hammersmith Odeon 1975
results.original_title: Supertramp: Crime of the Century in Concert at Hammersmith Odeon 1975
results.overview: Supertramp: Crime of the Century in Concert at Hammersmith Odeon 1975 is a comprehensive release capturing the British progressive rock band's landmark March 9, 1975 show in London. Restored from original 16mm film, this release features a Dolby Atmos audio mix and a setlist that bookends their hit album. Just prior to embarking on their first major North American tour in 1975, Supertramp played a highly anticipated, sold-out show at London's Hammersmith Odeon. This performance showcased the classic line-up of Rick Davies, Roger Hodgson, Dougie Thomson, John Helliwell, and Bob Siebenberg at the critical moment Crime of the Century was propelling them to global fame.

results.title: The Specials
results.overview: Former assassin Daiya has long left the criminal world, but he decides to take up a mission to kill a rival gang boss for a huge payday. The catch: To kill his target at a talent show, he must go undercover and perform in a pop dance group.

results.title: No Volveré
results.overview: A lonely ventriloquist is served divorce papers at the showroom bar where he works. Things take a strange turn when he tries to remedy the situation with his puppet, Luis.

results.title: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive
results.original_title: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive
results.overview: The fully authorized Vincent Price documentary reveals far more than the man behind Hollywood’s master of the macabre. It traces a life of elegant contradictions: a classically trained actor who redefined screen villainy with charm and intelligence, an erudite art lover and seasoned gourmand who found equal joy in low-budget horror and high culture, and—ironically, in his later years—a warm, avuncular patriarch to generations who grew up on his films, television appearances, and iconic voice. Through rare archives and deeply personal interviews, the film explores how Price embraced this unexpected cultural role, transforming from a suave antagonist into a beloved mentor figure whose presence felt both timeless and reassuring.

results.title: Bullying, our lives after
results.overview: What if we changed viewpoints? "Bullying, our lives after" highlights the suffering of adults who were once bullied pupils. Ten, twenty or thirty years later, trauma is still present. Following Nathalie, Laurine and Samuel, this movie shows the long-term implications of bullying, pointing out a real failure of the educational institution and a major public health issue.

results.title: Deep Quiet Room
results.overview: After his pregnant wife Yi-ting unexpectedly committed suicide, Ming decides to take care of his father-in-law, only to find out the unbearable truth of Yi-ting’s family that leads to her death.

results.title: Our Way to You
results.original_title: Ce qui nous mène à toi
results.overview: Charlie and Hicham, both in their thirties, are deeply in love but unable to conceive; they are facing infertility. They embark on a journey of medically assisted reproduction. Over the course of three years—amidst hopes and disappointments—they put both their love and their bodies to the test, living through an odyssey that will profoundly transform them.

results.title: Tiga Andartu Cancel Raya
results.overview: Munah, Jasmin and Lin are determined to cancel the Aidilfitri celebration in their village out of spite.

results.title: Strays
results.overview: Orestis, in his early thirties, is a conscientious objector facing the loss of his family home due to fines imposed for refusing military service. As the pressure mounts, he finds himself torn between his principles, his relationship with his father, and his responsibility towards his friends.

results.title: Brytbussen
results.overview: With over 15,000 participants and millions of television viewers worldwide, the Vasaloppet is one of Sweden’s most popular sporting events—a 90-kilometer race that can take some competitors up to 16 hours to complete. But what happens to those who drop out? Those who haven’t trained enough, who lack sufficient grip wax—or perhaps those who have fallen and broken a ski pole? The reasons for quitting are countless, but these skiers share one thing in common: the unpleasant journey to Mora in the "dropout bus."

results.title: Welcome to G-Town
results.overview: Three down-on their luck graduates struggling to find their place in Glasgow become embroiled into a shape-shifting alien conspiracy to take over the job market and destroy Scotland.

results.title: Strike - Figli di un’era sbagliata
results.overview: At a rehab center, 3 unlikely friends, an awkward psychology student on placement, a misbehaving student, and a reformed troublemaker - bond over hilarious misadventures and heartfelt advice, facing life's challenges together.
